title: Comelec sees 4M new voters for 2028 polls; sets Sept 2027 for COC filing
summary: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) on Sunday is expecting an additional four million registered voters for the 2028 national and local elections (NLE), as it set the filing of certificates of…

blocks.text: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) on Sunday is expecting an additional four million registered voters for the 2028 national and local elections (NLE), as it set the filing of certificates of candidacy (COCs) from September 20 to 26, 2027.

“Mga three million ang target natin [sa voter registration]. Pero sa sobrang laki ng mga nagpaparehistro bawat araw… baka abutin pa tayo ng apat na milyon,” Comelec chairperson George Garcia told Super Radyo dzBB.
(Our target for voter registration is around three million. But given the huge number of people registering every day, we may reach as many as four million.)
“Sa kasalukuyan, mga 140,000 to 150,000 na ang nagparehistro simula November 10,” he added.
(As of now, around 140,000 to 150,000 people have registered since November 10.)
Comelec has scheduled the voter registration from November 10, 2026 to July 30, 2027.
Earlier this month, Comelec urged eligible voters to register early and to take advantage of the long voter registration period rather than wait to do it at the last minute.
Garcia reiterated that the 2028 NLE would push through, saying it would be “impossible” to postpone it since it is mandated by the 1987 Philippine Constitution.
“100% namin ginagarantiya sa sambayanan na may halalan po tayo para sa 2028 (We 100% guarantee that we will have the election in 2028),” Garcia said.
He added that preparations for the 2028 elections are underway, with Comelec set to begin procuring at least 135,000 vote-counting machines for 2028 polls.
Almost P23 billion was allocated for the procurement of the machines that will be leased for the 2028 polls. —RF, GMA News
